sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 8522 of 2021
Applicant :- Sandeep

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- P.K. Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Vishvendra Singh
Hon'ble Saurabh Shyam Shamshery,J.
1.

Applicant has approached this Court by way of filing present bail application seeking enlargement
on bail in Case Crime No. 112 of 2019, under Sections 498A, 304-B Ipc and 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police
Station- Khera Rathaur, District- Agra.
2.  This bail application is pending before Court for last about three years.
Sri P.K. Singh, learned counsel for applicant is not present and present status of trial is also not on record.
3. This Court finds that in some of cases Advocates are not appearing possibly on ground that they have no instructions or nothing survives in the matter.

However, being an Advocate and Officer of Court, they are under legal obligation to appear before Court and assist, whether they have received proper instructions or not as the Vakalatnama filed by them has put them under solemn duty to Sandeep vs State Of U.P. on 14 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/52651223/
1 appear before Court.

4. Sri Roshan Kumar Singh, learned AGA appearing for State, submits that applicant, who is in jail since 01.11.2020, is facing trial for offence under Sections 498A, 304 -B IPC and 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
However, present status of trial is not on record.

5. In aforesaid circumstances, taking note of evidence against applicant and that present status of trial is not on record and also that applicant is in jail since 01.11.2020, therefore, even in absence of counsel for applicant, in the interest of justice, this application is disposed of with observation that in case trial is not concluded till date, applicant will have liberty to approach this Court or Trial Court concerned, as advised, afresh alongwith status of trial.
Meanwhile, Trial Court shall take all endeavour to conclude trial.
6. A copy of this order be communicated to applicant through Jail Superintendent concerned.

Order Date :- 14.5.2024 P. Pandey  Sandeep vs State Of U.P. on 14 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/52651223/
